exposure: average continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) time in range (TIR) during pregnancy (>70% vs. ≤70%)
cohort: 65 pregnant women with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) or gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) using CGM during pregnancy
finding: Among people with T2DM or GDM who utilized CGM during pregnancy, 4 out 10 individuals had TIR ≤70% and, compared with those with TIR > 70%, they had a higher likelihood of adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Individuals with time in range ≤70% were more likely to have cesarean delivery compared with those with time in range >70%.
